correctness.rationale: For each nonzero partial idempotent e, its image R consists exactly of fixed points and is contained in domain D. Orthogonality ef=fe=0 is exactly im(e)∩dom(f)=∅ and im(f)∩dom(e)=∅. For neighbor f of image rank s, choose S outside domain D of size s, set f identity on S, undefined on R, and choose for each of the n-r-s other points undefined or one of s images: binom(n-d,s)(s+1)^(n-r-s); summing gives degree. Multiplicity binom(n,r)binom(n-r,d-r)r^(d-r) is direct count. Isolates d=n; singleton p_x give <=3 paths and distinct complementary partial identities show diameter>=3 n>=3; clique <=n by pairwise disjoint fixed images and attained by p_x. Neighborhood strictness establishes unique max singleton degrees, min1 complementary identities. Independent complete brute force n=2,3,4 checked degrees, isolates, diameter.
